svg.text: Verification evidence and remaining release gates
Each case includes its exact netlist, simulator log, compressed sampled trace and machine-readable acceptance checks.
SIMULATION CANDIDATE - bounded models only; no construction, procurement or physical commissioning release
Normal case peak drain 33.06 V; shorted-pump case peak current 4.80 A.
ADC-off case final input 0.0656 V; post-settling rail injection remains below 1 uA.
The 1 us rail-fall case also meets the modeled absolute input limits; brief injection is separately retained in its trace.
No automatic restart after E-stop, brownout or logic loss; fresh reset with permit low restores a controlled run.
20 us repeats cover E-stop and shorted load; the short repeat uses first-order integration. This is a numerical check.
Before selecting and building actual hardware
1. Freeze pump/valve datasheets, real coil/inrush/BLDC behavior, MOSFET SOA, suppression and fuse coordination.
2. Realize and independently review the watchdog, reset latch, coil drivers, GPIO interfaces and protected ADC circuit.
3. Review bench photographs and continuity; issue the actual pin/terminal wire schedule and matched <=INR15,000 basket.
4. Perform unpowered checks, dry electrical tests, passive leak checks, read-only calibration and attended protected trials.
Primary source constraints: TI ADS1115 / TMUX1511; ADI MAX14626. Model inventory and source links: README.md.
